purpose: one-time validation of the predicate layer against real production Solidity. NOT a vendored corpus case.
why_not_vendored: Third-party code is not copied into this repository. Reproducibility comes from URL + commit in this manifest.

verification.build: forge build succeeds after npm install (forge-std is an npm dependency, remapped)
verification.test_count_method: two independent counts: forge test summary (22 tests passed) and static grep of `function test` across tests/foundry/*.sol (12+4+6=22)

declared_limitation: This repository contains no stateful invariant_* functions. Its properties are universal statements over pure functions (verify(forged) == false). Validating a function-return predicate here does not exercise RustyFuzz's state-machine machinery, and is expected to find no new bug, because Foundry's own fuzzer already covers this class faster for a stateless library.
scope_decision: Validation exercise only. 2-3 day detour to prove the predicate layer works on real code.
